notes.title: Demo Trailer Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031480/29b86ed3b83e682b802cdaef53de37cf4bb225db.png[/img]
[h1]An official demo trailer has been created and added to the store page![/h1]

Finally! With the upcoming release of the demo (in 4 days!), I'm really looking forward to hearing things from people. Particularly interested in wondering whether anyone will [i]actually[/i] find out how to complete all the content in the demo... 

Wanted to give a huge shoutout to my fantastic friend Gabriel David Williams for the work on this trailer! His musical and artistic talents are already a huge addition, despite only recently joining me on this game development process. Really looking forward to hearing, and potentially even seeing reactions! 

Good luck, playtesters.
